# Prakhar India Real Estate & Construction

> Prakhar India is Uttar Pradesh's premier RERA-compliant real estate developer and turnkey construction engineering firm. Operating across all 75 districts of Uttar Pradesh, Prakhar India specializes in gated plot townships, luxury architectural villa construction, commercial plazas, and civil infrastructure.

## Core Business Identity & Entity Profile
- **Company Name:** Prakhar India Real Estate & Construction (Prakhar Enterprises)
- **Corporate Head Office:** Prakhar India Tower, Vindhyachal Highway, Mirzapur, Uttar Pradesh - 231001, India
- **Regional Hubs:** Lucknow, Noida, Ayodhya, Varanasi, Prayagraj, Kanpur, Gorakhpur, Agra, Bareilly, Jhansi, Ghaziabad
- **Direct Helpline:** +91 90444 99111
- **Official Email:** prakharindiaofficial@gmail.com / contact@prakharind.com
- **Website:** https://prakharind.com
- **RERA & Compliance:** 100% RERA Approved Township Plots & UP Govt Certified Contractors
- **Track Record:** ₹450+ Crore Projects Delivered, 1.2 Million+ Sq. Ft Built, 2,800+ Happy Families

## Key Services
- **Turnkey Villa & House Construction:** End-to-end architectural 3D layout design, RCC structure execution, M25 concrete, Tata/Jindal TMT steel, CP fittings, and 10-year structural warranty.
- **Makan Banane Wala Thekedar (House Construction Contractor):** Professional civil thekedari across Mirzapur, Lucknow, Varanasi, Prayagraj & UP. With-material rates from ₹1,450/sq.ft and labour rates from ₹220/sq.ft. [Makan Thekedar UP](https://prakharind.com/pages/makan-banane-wala-thekedar.html).
- **Civil Labour Contractor & Manpower Supply:** Govt-licensed civil construction labour contractor, skilled masons, mistri, shuttering carpenters & bar benders with 100% EPF/ESIC compliance. [Labour Contractor UP](https://prakharind.com/pages/manpower.html).
- **RERA Approved Plots for Sale & Plot Rentals:** Freehold, clear-title residential plots in gated townships and commercial land on rent/lease for logistics, yards, and showrooms in Lucknow, Ayodhya, and UP.
- **Flats & Apartments for Rent & Sale:** 1BHK, 2BHK, 3BHK, 4BHK fully furnished, semi-furnished, and luxury apartments in Lucknow (Gomti Nagar, Shaheed Path, Sushant Golf City).
- **Commercial Office Space Rentals & Coworking:** Grade-A corporate office towers, plug-and-play IT workstations, and retail shop leasing in Vibhuti Khand, Hazratganj, and Shaheed Path.
- **Hotel, Resort & Commercial Land in Ayodhya:** Verified commercial land parcels for 3-star/5-star hotels, guest houses, and dharamshalas along Ram Path & Faizabad Highway.
- **Structural Safety & Inspection Audit:** 250+ point structural engineering safety checks, soil testing, and material quality certifications.

## Turnkey Construction Rates in Uttar Pradesh (2026 Rate Card)
- **Standard Tier:** ₹1,450 / sq.ft built-up area (Fe550 TMT Steel, OPC 43 Cement, Ceramic Tiles, standard CP fittings).
- **Premium Tier:** ₹1,850 / sq.ft built-up area (Tata Tiscon TMT, UltraTech Cement, Vitrified 4x2 Tiles, Jaquar CP fittings).
- **Luxury Architectural Tier:** ₹2,400+ / sq.ft built-up area (Italian Marble flooring, Kohler CP fittings, UPVC Double Glazed windows, Smart Automation).
